IMPLEMENTATION NUANCE FOR 023C (advisory, not a finding): The --signer-workflow flag in gh attestation verify matches against the job_workflow_ref extension in the Sigstore certificate SAN, which records the exact ref used when the calling workflow triggered policy-check.yml. If an adopter's wrapper pins policy-check.yml@<sha> (commit SHA), the SAN records that SHA; the aggregator's --signer-workflow argument must also specify the same SHA to match. The plan correctly uses <sha> as the placeholder (consistent with SCP SHA-pinning conventions throughout the plan-doc) and the surrounding text says 'the SHA pin the adopter's caller wrapper specifies' — unambiguous intent. The practical implementation question (how does the aggregator determine each adopter's current SHA pin?) will be resolved at 023C: the aggregator reads each adopter's wrapper file from opt-in-registry.yaml to extract the SHA pin, then constructs the --signer-workflow argument dynamically. This is an implementation detail within 023C's scope, not a plan-doc gap. 023C's R1 safety review will verify the SHA-binding is correctly implemented and not weakened to branch-ref matching.
